scholarships.title: IIT Kanpur Institute Fellowship (for International Students)

existing.description: Doctoral-fellowship in India for ASEAN (DIA) (Government of India)
eligibility: Not a citizen of India by birth or naturalisation, and/or an OCI or PIO card holder, so treated as a foreign national
Must hold a qualifying degree for the applied MTech, MS (Research), MDes, MBA or PhD programme
Must not be in receipt of any other funding, since only students who receive no other funding are eligible for the Institute Fellowship
Foreign nationals must complete registration on the Study in India portal, which is linked to study visa issuance
Registration for admission by 27 July 2026 for the July 2026 session
existing.eligibility_summary: Foreign nationals, meaning candidates who are not citizens of India by birth or naturalisation and/or who hold OCI or PIO cards, admitted to an MTech, MS (Research), MDes, MBA or PhD programme at IIT Kanpur who are not in receipt of any other funding. The Institute Fellowship is limited to those who do not receive other funding.
benefits: Monthly fellowship at par with Indian students
Access to IIT Kanpur's international relations support, including FRRO registration assistance on arrival
Possibility of being considered for a more comprehensive Government of India or partner scheme instead
coverage: Monthly fellowship for foreign degree students at par with Indian students

Access to separate Government of India funded schemes such as ICCR Scholarship, Study in India, AARDO Fellowship, ASEAN DIA doctoral fellowship and the India Bhutan Friendship Scholarship, for candidates who qualify for those instead
requirements: Register on the Study in India portal, which is mandatory for all foreign students intending to pursue higher education in India and is linked to study visa issuance
Apply through the IIT Kanpur online admission portal when admissions are open
Application fee is waived for candidates in the Foreign National category
GATE qualification requirement is waived for candidates in the Foreign National category
Candidates who apply under Government of India schemes such as ICCR or ASEAN DIA must apply through those schemes' own portals rather than IIT Kanpur's
documents: Qualifying degree certificate, original or provisional
Mark or grade sheet of the qualifying degree as a single PDF file
No Objection Certificate, only for sponsored, part-time or external candidates
existing.english_requirement: Not separately stated for the Institute Fellowship. All admissions and scholarship materials are published by IIT Kanpur in English.
application_method: For direct IIT Kanpur admission, apply through the online portal during the relevant intake window
For Government of India funded categories, apply on the relevant scheme portal, such as Study in India, ICCR or the ASEAN portal, with the IIT Kanpur office of international relations advising
The candidate's academic record is assessed by the concerned department, which is the ultimate decision maker
existing.selection_notes: The competent committees of the departments are the ultimate decision makers in student selection. Foreign national applicants may be interviewed. Where a candidate holds an OCI or PIO card they are eligible to apply through the IIT Kanpur application portal.
existing.best_fit: International applicants admitted to an MTech, MS (Research), MDes, MBA or PhD programme at IIT Kanpur who are not receiving funding from any other scheme.
existing.notes: The Institute Fellowship is a fallback monthly fellowship, not a full financial package. Published tuition and hostel charges still apply to foreign nationals, for example PhD SAARC USD 250 plus INR 17,495, PhD non-SAARC USD 500 plus INR 17,495, MTech SAARC USD 500 plus INR 17,495, MTech non-SAARC USD 750 plus INR 17,495, MBA SAARC USD 2,000 plus INR 17,495 and MBA non-SAARC USD 4,000 plus INR 17,495. Candidates who can obtain ICCR, Study in India, AARDO, ASEAN DIA or India Bhutan funding should apply through those schemes instead, which are more comprehensive.
existing.duration: Tied to the degree programme, for MTech, MS (Research), MDes, MBA or PhD as admitted
existing.application_period: Two intakes a year. Spring PhD: 1 September to 31 October. Autumn MTech, MBA, MDes and PhD: 20 March to 15 April. Foreign national applications for the 2026 autumn intake closed on 15 April 2026.

existing.program_type: Institute-funded monthly fellowship for admitted international degree students
